title: Entrepreneurship & Innovation
tagline: From research leadership to innovation-driven enterprise.
intro: Innovation is not limited to the development of new technologies. It also involves building collaborative ecosystems, creating opportunities for knowledge exchange, and connecting scientific research with practical applications. Prof. Dr. Ajith Abraham's professional journey extends across academic leadership, international research collaboration, and enterprise-oriented initiatives. Through research networks and technology-related organisations, his work reflects an interest in strengthening the relationship between academia, industry, and innovation.

featured.name: Machine Intelligence Research Labs (MIR Labs)
paragraphs: Machine Intelligence Research Labs (MIR Labs) was established in 2008 as a non-profit academic consortium dedicated to innovation and research excellence. Its mission centres on bringing together researchers, scientists, universities, and industry professionals to advance research in machine intelligence and related technological fields.

Under Prof. Dr. Abraham's founding leadership, MIR Labs developed an international scientific networking platform that encouraged interdisciplinary collaboration, research partnerships, academic conferences, workshops, and knowledge exchange.
Its activities span areas such as machine intelligence, data science, cyber-physical systems, Internet of Things, network intelligence, and applied computational research.
The initiative reflects a research-led approach to innovation: connecting people, institutions, and ideas to address complex scientific and technological challenges.

enterprises.name: DetectIQ Private Limited
facts: AI-assisted CT analysis for colorectal imaging
paragraphs: DetectIQ Private Limited is an India-based health-technology company developing AI-assisted CT analysis for colorectal imaging. Its flagship product, ColonView™, turns a routine abdominal CT scan into structured, reviewable colorectal information — without any additional imaging procedure.

ColonView™ is built around two clinical questions: whether the colon is adequately prepared to be read, and what the scan contains. It combines automated bowel-preparation assessment based on the Boston Bowel Preparation Scale (BBPS) with polyp detection, segmentation of colon and lesion regions, and lesion measurement for clinical review.

Because colorectal cancers often develop through a slow polyp-to-cancer pathway, earlier visual support can be valuable — yet small and flat lesions are easy to miss, and bowel preparation, distension, and image quality all add difficulty. ColonView™ is designed to add standardised visual support within existing CT workflows, guided by the idea of "Visualizing Health, in a New Light."

The initiative reflects a continued engagement with applied, translational innovation — bringing a machine-intelligence perspective to a clinically motivated venture, currently in the validation stage and developed with hospital and cancer-centre collaborators.

enterprises.name: Wellermind Technologies Private Limited
facts: Registered with ROC Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh
paragraphs: Wellermind Technologies Private Limited is an Indian technology company incorporated on 4 October 2024 and registered with the Registrar of Companies, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh. Classified under NIC 62011, the company operates within the computer programming and software development domain, encompassing the broader landscape of digital technologies and software engineering.

The company's leadership includes Prof. Dr. Ajith Padath Abraham, alongside Yana Gaur and Abhay Chaudhary, as listed in public corporate records. Its association with an established academic and technology professional adds an academic dimension to its organisational profile.

With its foundation in the technology sector, Wellermind Technologies represents an emerging enterprise in India's evolving digital ecosystem. Its registered business domain provides a foundation for exploring software development, digital solutions, application engineering, and technology-driven initiatives.
